module asyn_fifo #(
    parameter DEPTH = 16,
    parameter WIDTH = 8,
    parameter ADDR_WIDTH = $clog2(DEPTH)
) (
    input 					wclk,
    input 					rclk,
    input 					wrstn,
    input					rrstn,
    input 					winc,
    input 			 		rinc,
    input 		[WIDTH-1:0]	wdata,
    output wire				wfull,
    output wire				rempty,
    output reg [WIDTH-1:0]	rdata
);

endmodule

module dual_port_RAM #(parameter DEPTH = 16,  parameter WIDTH = 8)
(
	 input wclk	,
	 input wenc	,
	 input [$clog2(DEPTH)-1:0] waddr  ,
	 input [WIDTH-1:0] wdata ,
	 input rclk	,
	 input renc	,
	 input [$clog2(DEPTH)-1:0] raddr ,
	 output reg [WIDTH-1:0] rdata 		
);

reg [WIDTH-1:0] RAM_MEM [0:DEPTH-1];

always @(posedge wclk) begin
	if(wenc)
		RAM_MEM[waddr] <= wdata;
end 

always @(posedge rclk) begin
	if(renc)
		rdata <= RAM_MEM[raddr];
end 

endmodule
samples.xml_description:
<module id="asyn_fifo">
    <description>Asynchronous FIFO with configurable parameters WIDTH and DEPTH.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="wclk">Write clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rclk">Read clock signal.</input>
        <input id="wrstn">Write reset signal.</input>
        <input id="rrstn">Read reset signal.</input>
        <input id="winc">Write increment signal.</input>
        <input id="rinc">Read increment signal.</input>
        <input id="wdata" width_description="[WIDTH-1:0]">Write data input.</input>
        <output id="wfull">Write full signal.</output>
        <output id="rempty">Read empty signal.</output>
        <output id="rdata" width_description="[WIDTH-1:0]">Read data output.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <param id="WIDTH">FIFO data width.</param>
        <param id="DEPTH">FIFO depth.</param>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        <assign id="wen" value="winc && !wfull" />
        <assign id="ren" value="rinc && !rempty" />
        <assign id="waddr" value="waddr_bin[$clog2(DEPTH)-1:0]" />
        <assign id="raddr" value="raddr_bin[$clog2(DEPTH)-1:0]" />
        <assign id="wptr" value="{waddr_bin[$clog2(DEPTH)-1], ^waddr_bin[$clog2(DEPTH)-2:0]}" />
        <assign id="rptr" value="{raddr_bin[$clog2(DEPTH)-1], ^raddr_bin[$clog2(DEPTH)-2:0]}" />
        <assign id="wptr_buff" value="{wptr_buff[$clog2(DEPTH)-1], ^wptr_buff[$clog2(DEPTH)-2:0]}" />
        <assign id="rptr_buff" value="{rptr_buff[$clog2(DEPTH)-1], ^rptr_buff[$clog2(DEPTH)-2:0]}" />
        <assign id="wfull" value="(wptr == {~rptr_buff[$clog2(DEPTH)-1], rptr_buff[$clog2(DEPTH)-2:0]}) ? 1 : 0" />
        <assign id="rempty" value=(rptr == wptr_buff) ? 1 : 0" />
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // Dual-port RAM instance
        dual_port_RAM #(.WIDTH(WIDTH), .DEPTH(DEPTH)) ram (
            .wclk(wclk),
            .wenc(wen),
            .waddr(waddr),
            .wdata(wdata),
            .rclk(rclk),
            .renc(ren),
            .raddr(raddr),
            .rdata(rdata)
        );
        
        // Write pointer logic
        always @(posedge wclk or negedge wrstn) begin
            if (!wrstn) begin
                waddr_bin <= 0;
            end else begin
                if (winc & !wfull) begin
                    waddr_bin <= waddr_bin + 1;
                end
            end
        end
        
        // Read pointer logic
        always @(posedge rclk or negedge rrstn) begin
            if (!rrstn) begin
                raddr_bin <= 0;
            end else begin
                if (rinc & !rempty) begin
                    raddr_bin <= raddr_bin + 1;
                end
            end
        end
        
        // Buffering write pointer
        always @(posedge wclk or negedge wrstn) begin
            if (!wrstn) begin
                wptr_buff <= 0;
            end else begin
                wptr_buff <= wptr;
            end
        end
        
        // Buffering read pointer
        always @(posedge rclk or negedge rrstn) begin
            if (!rrstn) begin
                rptr_buff <= 0;
            end else begin
                rptr_buff <= rptr;
            end
        end
        
        // Synchronizing read pointer
        reg [$clog2(DEPTH):0] rptr_syn;
        always @(posedge wclk or negedge wrstn) begin
            if (!wrstn) begin
                rptr_syn <= 0;
            end else begin
                rptr_syn <= rptr_buff;
            end
        end
        
        // Synchronizing write pointer
        reg [$clog2(DEPTH):0] wptr_syn;
        always @(posedge rclk or negedge rrstn) begin
            if (!rrstn) begin
                wptr_syn <= 0;
            end else begin
                wptr_syn <= wptr;
            end
        end
    </implementation>
    
    <task>
        <description>
            Task to compare two pointers and return their equality status.
            
            Parameters:
                p1: First pointer
                p2: Second pointer
            
            Returns:
                1 if p1 equals p2, otherwise 0
        </description>
        <block id="compare_pointer">
            <input id="p1" width_description="[($clog2(DEPTH)+1)]">First pointer to compare.</input>
            <input id="p2" width_description="[($clog2(DEPTH)+1)]">Second pointer to compare.</input>
            <output id="equal">Equality result (1 if equal, 0 otherwise).</output>
            <if condition="p1 == p2">
                <set id="equal" value="1" />
            </else>
            <else>
                <set id="equal" value="0" />
            </else>
        </block>
    </task>
</module>
